import boto3
import pandas as pd
import io

# 1. READ FROM S3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
bucket_name = 'forex-analytics-2026'
input_key = 'raw/forex_trading_journal.csv'

obj = s3.get_object(Bucket=bucket_name, Key=input_key)
df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(obj['Body'].read()))

print("=== BEFORE CLEANING ===")
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Missing values:\n", df.isnull().sum())

# 2. CLEAN

# Fix missing Result — 711 BE trades
df['Result'] = df['Result'].fillna('Breakeven')

# Standardize casing
df['Session']   = df['Session'].str.strip().str.title()
df['Direction'] = df['Direction'].str.strip().str.title()
df['Day']       = df['Day'].str.strip().str.title()
df['Result']    = df['Result'].str.strip().str.title()
df['Pair']      = df['Pair'].str.strip().str.upper()

# Convert Date to datetime
df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])

# 3. TRANSFORM 

# Extract Year, Month, Quarter
df['Year']    = df['Date'].dt.year
df['Month']   = df['Date'].dt.month_name()
df['Quarter'] = df['Date'].dt.quarter.apply(lambda x: f'Q{x}')
df['Week']    = df['Date'].dt.isocalendar().week.astype(int)

# Win flag
df['Is_Win'] = (df['Result'] == 'Win').astype(int)

# Loss flag
df['Is_Loss'] = (df['Result'] == 'Loss').astype(int)

# Cumulative PnL
df = df.sort_values('Date').reset_index(drop=True)
df['Cumulative_PnL'] = df['PnL'].cumsum().round(2)

# Cumulative Balance check
df['Running_Balance'] = df['Account_Balance']

# Trade outcome category
def trade_outcome(row):
    if row['Result'] == 'Win':
        return 'Profitable'
    elif row['Result'] == 'Loss':
        return 'Loss'
    else:
        return 'Breakeven'

df['Outcome'] = df.apply(trade_outcome, axis=1)

# RR Category
def rr_category(rr):
    if rr >= 3:
        return 'High RR'
    elif rr >= 2:
        return 'Medium RR'
    else:
        return 'Low RR'

df['RR_Category'] = df['RR'].apply(rr_category)

# Session + Pair combo
df['Session_Pair'] = df['Session'] + ' - ' + df['Pair']

# 4. VERIFY
print("\n=== AFTER CLEAN + TRANSFORM ===")
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Missing values:\n", df.isnull().sum())
print("\nUnique Results:", df['Result'].unique())
print("Unique Sessions:", df['Session'].unique())
print("Unique Pairs:", df['Pair'].unique())
print("\nWin/Loss/Breakeven counts:")
print(df['Result'].value_counts())
print("\nTrades per Year:")
print(df['Year'].value_counts().sort_index())
print("\nTrades per Pair:")
print(df['Pair'].value_counts())
print("\nTotal PnL: $", round(df['PnL'].sum(), 2))
print("Final Balance: $", df['Account_Balance'].iloc[-1])
print("\nNew columns:", ['Year','Month','Quarter','Week',
      'Is_Win','Is_Loss','Cumulative_PnL',
      'Outcome','RR_Category','Session_Pair'])

# 5. SAVE TO S3 
output_key = 'cleaned/cleaned_forex_data.csv'
csv_buffer = io.StringIO()
df.to_csv(csv_buffer, index=False)
s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket_name, Key=output_key, Body=csv_buffer.getvalue())

print("\n✅ Saved to s3://forex-analytics-2026/cleaned/cleaned_forex_data.csv")
